name: pr-workflow
description: Rules for agents working on pull requests: habits for any PR the session opens, author grants in configured repos, and the maintainer-side intake in configured repos. A hook names the rules before the first gh call to a configured repo.

author_repos.title: Author repos
author_repos.description: Comma-separated owner/repo list where the author grants apply (approve without asking, update from the default branch without asking, the required review loop).

intake_repos.title: Intake repos
intake_repos.description: Comma-separated owner/repo list where you are the maintainer and the intake rules apply to PRs the session didn't open.

gate_status.title: Gate status
gate_status.description: Name of the commit status the intake sets on a head the owner agreed to (empty: no gate status).

standing_merge.title: Standing merge
standing_merge.description: Whether the intake merges a ready PR without asking. Release PRs always need an explicit go-ahead.

bot_logins.title: Bot logins
bot_logins.description: Comma-separated bot PR authors in API form (e.g. dependabot[bot]) whose PRs may get a clean update from the default branch from the maintainer side.
